services.name: Netflix Standard
services.cancelGuide: Sign in at netflix.com, open Account, then select Cancel Membership. Access continues until the end of the current billing period.

services.name: Spotify Premium
services.cancelGuide: Open your Spotify account page in a browser, go to Available plans, and choose Cancel Premium. Your account reverts to the free tier after the paid period ends.
